title: 12 Best Calgary's Craft Beer Scene
description: Explore Calgary's vibrant craft beer scene with our expert guide to the 12 best breweries. Discover award-winning IPAs, cozy taprooms, and dog-friendly patios. Find your perfect pint!

places.name: Establishment Brewing Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Fat Rainbow' Hazy IPA or any of their award-winning sour beers. Pair it with their delicious Fried Chicken Sandwich.

places.name: Eighty-Eight Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Hammer Pants' New England IPA or their 'Wave Pool' Pineapple Sour. Don't leave without trying a slice of their excellent pizza.

places.name: Cabin Brewing Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Sunshine Rain' Tropical IPA or any of their rotating seasonal stouts. The 'Super Saturation' Hazy IPA is also a consistent winner.

places.name: Cold Garden Beverage Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Cakeface' Vanilla Cream Ale or their 'East Calgary Lager' for something crisp. If you're adventurous, try their rotating 'Berliner Weisse' series.

places.name: Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their flagship 'Okami Kasu' Japanese Rice Ale for something unique, or the 'Pegasus' Pale Ale for a solid classic. Their smash burgers are excellent.

places.name: The Dandy Brewing Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Dandy in the Underworld' Oyster Stout or a rotating sour. Their sourdough pizza or a unique small plate from their kitchen are must-tries.

places.name: Last Best Brewing & Distilling
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Dirty Bird' Black Lager or their 'Last Best IPA'. Explore their cocktail menu featuring their own distilled spirits, like the 'Fortunella G&T'.

places.name: Tool Shed Brewing Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature 'People Skills' Cream Ale or the 'Star Cheek' IPA. Pair it with one of their delicious burgers or poutine.

places.name: Village Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp 'Village Blonde' or their 'Village Squeeze' Grapefruit Ale for something refreshing. Their seasonal offerings are always worth a try.

places.name: Common Crown Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their award-winning 'IPA' or the 'Copacabana' Blonde Ale. Grab a giant pretzel with beer cheese for the perfect snack pairing.

places.name: Revival Brewcade
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Pixelated Pilsner' or a rotating experimental IPA. Their Detroit-style pizzas are a must-have while you play.

places.name: Banded Peak Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their flagship 'Summit Seeker' IPA or the 'Plainsbreaker' Pale Ale. Check which food truck is on site for their daily specials.
